definitions.explanation: A small humanoid or animal figure made of clay, primarily associated with the Jomon period (circa 14,000-300 BCE) of Japanese prehistory. These artifacts are considered important cultural properties.

examples.english: I went to see the clay figurines.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{土偶|どぐう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{縄文|じょうもん}{時代|じだい}→縄文時代：18895_joumonjidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだそうだ。
examples.english: This clay figurine is said to be from the Jomon period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出土|しゅつど}→出土：11760_shutsudo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{土偶|どぐう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The museum displays numerous clay figurines excavated from all over the country.

notes:
USAGE:
{土偶|どぐう} refers specifically to the clay figurines from prehistoric Japan, especially the ⟦{縄文|じょうもん}{時代|じだい}→縄文時代：18895_joumonjidai⟧ (Jomon period). They are distinct from ⟦{埴輪|はにわ}→埴輪：18667_haniwa⟧, which are the hollow clay figures placed around burial mounds during the later ⟦{古墳|こふん}{時代|じだい}→古墳時代：23333_kofunjidai⟧ (Kofun period).

CULTURAL NOTE:
The most famous {土偶|どぐう} is the {遮光器|しゃこうき}{土偶|どぐう} (goggle-eyed figurine), recognized for its distinctive large eyes. Many {土偶|どぐう} have been designated as ⟦{国宝|こくほう}→国宝：09642_kokuhou⟧ (national treasures). Their exact purpose remains debated, but they are thought to have served ritual or spiritual functions.

- {縄文|じょうもん}{土偶|どぐう}: Jomon-period clay figurine
